governance.rationale: This protected service-key route may dispatch only the fixed repository-owned Production workflow after environment, contract, exact-SHA, idempotency, and server-controlled target checks. The broker never accepts database names, credentials, arbitrary refs, or workflow paths; runtime_env remains dry-run-only and all mutation modes remain separately gated by the workflow contract.

The environment-scoped Breakglass plan endpoint only resolves the repository-owned contract matrix and safe deployment metadata. It does not dispatch GitHub, connect to a database, mutate state, or expose target identifiers.

surface_decision.rationale: Environment-scoped Runtime Breakglass status, planning, dispatch, and bounded readback are internal service-key operational contracts. They are not browser navigation surfaces, do not expose credentials or database names, and remain subject to exact-SHA, plan, confirmation, and readback controls.

governance.rationale: Builds and hashes an immutable repository-owned recovery plan without database or provider mutation.

rollback.rationale: The API mutation is only a workflow dispatch. Database mutation remains behind environment approval and the bootstrap engine reports partial_possible with same-cycle readback; destructive nonempty rebuild is prohibited.

governance.rationale: Dispatches only the fixed repository workflow after exact-SHA, catalog, target-source, confirmation, and idempotency validation; execution remains gated by the Production environment and same-cycle readback.

surface_decision.rationale: Database-independent Admin recovery API is exposed only through the bounded Admin Core action surface; it is not a browser navigation surface and does not itself grant mutation authority.

governance.rationale: The Recovery Kernel call endpoint is a bounded discovery, inspection, finding, planning, preview, and approval-challenge preflight. It does not execute a mutation and rejects raw SQL, shell, credentials, arbitrary targets, and migration or grant selection.

rollback.rationale: The challenge is short-lived and non-transferable; revocation remains owned by the injected approval authority and no provider mutation is initiated by this operation.

governance.rationale: Approval challenge issuance persists a short-lived, step-bound control-plane challenge through injected approval authorities without executing a provider or database mutation. It remains private Recovery-only, requires explicit authority preflight, never returns the approval token, and cannot accept ticket or provider controls.

rollback.rationale: The bridge has no live executor in the default composition; any injected Host Breakglass executor remains subject to its own bounded compensation and readback contract.

governance.rationale: The private Recovery Action bridge accepts only plan, step, approval, and idempotency references. It issues the execution ticket server-side, reuses Recovery Kernel approval/fence/readback semantics, and forwards ticket references only to the explicitly injected Host Breakglass mutation boundary; the default composition remains fail-closed before provider or database mutation.

rollback.rationale: No execution authority is present by default; any future injected executor must supply its own bounded compensation contract before activation.

governance.rationale: Consequential Recovery Kernel execution is accepted only as an exact plan-hash, target-fingerprint, step, approval, lock, idempotency, executor, and same-cycle readback contract. The repository default has no durable authorities and therefore fails closed before mutation.

surface_decision.rationale: The Recovery Kernel is a private, Production-only administrative API and fixed system dispatcher. It is not a browser navigation surface, never accepts raw commands or credentials, and keeps consequential execution behind plan, approval, lock, idempotency, and readback gates.

rollback.rationale: Reservation performs no database mutation; an abandoned or unknown reservation remains fail-closed and requires governed reconciliation.

governance.rationale: Verifies and atomically reserves a server-issued, exact-SHA, single-use Staging grant-repair ticket before the local executor may mutate the bounded Staging databases.

rollback.rationale: Finalization records an immutable verified outcome after readback; failed or unknown outcomes remain blocked for reconciliation.

governance.rationale: Finalizes a previously reserved Staging execution ticket only after the repository-owned local executor supplies canonical same-cycle database grant readback.

rollback.rationale: The immutable receipt is compensating evidence and cannot authorize replay or any Production, provider, or DNS mutation.

governance.rationale: Persists an immutable, secret-free Staging reconciliation receipt when a reserved local grant-repair execution has a partial or unknown outcome.

surface_decision.rationale: The Staging Recovery Admin surface is a private API-only contract for activation-dev readiness and certification status.
